observations: Fresh native stats start at zero actual, zero total and zero current possible points.
SetDancePointLimits changes actual and total without advancing current possible points.
Negative actual or nonpositive possible leaves state unchanged and returns self.
A successful native setter returns the last Lua argument, rather than the stats userdata.
Player states remain isolated and missing or nonnumeric arguments raise Lua errors.
Lua numeric arguments, including numeric strings, truncate toward zero when stored; the setter returns the original last argument.
limits: This native getter/setter control does not simulate ScoreKeeperNormal judgment progress or gameplay screen reload.
